title: Laws about love for neighbors, purity, and sexual morality
description: The chapter gathers various laws given through Moses. First, about helping your brother with lost animals or property and lifting up an animal that has fallen. Then prohibitions against wearing clothing of the opposite sex, rules about bird's nests, requirements for a parapet on the roof, and prohibitions against mixing seeds, draft animals, and fabrics. Finally, a series of laws concerning sexual morality: false accusations of lack of virginity, adultery with a married woman, and abuse of an engaged or unmarried virgin, along with corresponding punishments.
